briefing.headline: OpenAI o4-preview and DeepSeek-R2 intensify AGI race as compute bottlenecks tighten

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases while governments scramble for compute controls. US-China export restrictions bite deeper as new models hit multi-modal reasoning benchmarks. Safety gaps widen in production deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4-preview with 2.1T parameters; Anthropic counters with Claude 4 Opus. Google Gemini 3 and Meta Llama 4 trail slightly while xAI Colossus cluster comes online. DeepSeek-R2 surprises with open weights at near-frontier performance.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level across multi-agent, automotive, IoT and BCI environments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 1.2M units shipped this quarter. Microsoft and Google announce joint $45B data-center expansion in Texas and Arizona. TSMC 2nm yields improve to 65% for custom AI ASICs.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first 10-trillion-parameter model trigger an international compute-sharing treaty or accelerate unilateral AGI deployment?
